rule: Keep a rung if its frozen-set R^2 of log e beats the incumbent by more than 0.01 AND its dev error (MdAPE on the VED ICE dev trips) is no more than 5% worse. Rungs = the conventional Pareto fronts of the searches in order of search, then complexity. The Vehicle Bake-off released its law by its own rule (sim val skill + D16 over all powertrains): bakeoff_released.
